text: Load a machine definition from a JSON file
Definition contains states, initial state, final states, transitions
Transitions have events (from state + event -> to state)
Transitions support optional guard conditions evaluated on a context
Validation: detect transitions/initial/final referencing unknown states
Run a sequence of events against the machine
Invalid/unhandled events and guard-blocked transitions handled with clear error (non-zero exit or reported), no traceback
Report final state / whether machine reached a final state
Malformed JSON / missing file handled gracefully without traceback
Guards evaluated safely (no arbitrary code execution, e.g. no eval of untrusted input)
